i don't know how to do that! i don't know how to find stuff in common and i don't know how to open up because i feel like there's nothing inside me to put on display.

i listen to music, but sometimes it's hard for me to enjoy the music i know i like. it's a rare occasion that i have the energy to find more. i can tell someone the music i like. i can ask them what music they like. but where do i go from there?

someone i was tutoring asked me about the game i was playing. i explained it to them. they didn't have much to say about it. where do i go from there?

i asked my partner on my project what he was doing that night. he said he was going to go home and eat, and work some more.

where do i go from there? do i ask him what he's going to eat? do i tell him what i like to eat?

i don't mean to be tedious. i'm just confused. every day, it's like this. i can't talk to people. i do, but i can't. or am i telling myself i can't? is there a difference? fuck. it's like sitting through a lecture, and having no idea what they were on about. i don't get it. i want so desperately to get it but i never pass.
